name: Titania
description: This hotel is located at the heart of the wonderful city of Athens. The hotel enjoys a prime setting, lying just a short distance away from many of the city's most prominent attractions. A wealth of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues are to be found nearby. Links to the public transport network are situated just a short distance from the hotel. This wonderful hotel is located just 8 km from the nearest golf course, while the international airport lies just 30 km away. This charming hotel enjoys a stunning design, blending effortlessly with its culturally-rich surroundings. The hotel offers a boundless array of exemplary facilities, meeting the needs of every type of traveller to a high level of excellence.
